ios.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Sparkly Brush uses Bluetooth to connect to your Philips Sonicare for Kids toothbrush and record brushing sessions.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Sparkly Brush uses Face ID only to open the parents’ area.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sparkly Brush uses the microphone only when you record a message for your child.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sparkly Brush uses the front camera only as a mirror while brushing: it takes no photos and records nothing.
